content:
Jordan: Quick triage — customer reports TTFT spikes. Where do I find p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec per-route? Any quick alert tuning tips? :eyes:

Priya: Start with the Grafana TTFT overview dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ttft/ttft-overview?orgId=1&var-env=prod
- Top-left: p50/p95/p99 timeseries (per-model & per-route)
- 'Tokens/sec' panel shows global and per-route token throughput
- Use the per-route dropdown to narrow to `route=generate`

Sam: PromQL snippets that I use:
```promql
# p95 from histogram buckets (5m window)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

# tokens/sec per route (1m)
sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (route)
```

Lina: For traces, open Jaeger and filter service=runtime, operation=Generate. Example Jaeger URL: https://jaeger.redwood.com/search?service=runtime&operation=Generate&tags=%7B%7D
Also enable 'Show KV cache hits' on the trace view to see cache/miss breakdown.

Priya: Alert tuning guidance:
- Don't fire on a single p95 blip: require p95 > X for 5m (or rising trend)
- Use combined conditions: p95 > threshold AND tokens/sec > baseline (to avoid alerts during low traffic)
- Keep p99 alerts stricter but shorter window for immediate attention
Example alert rule (p95 sustained):
```yaml
alert: HighTTFT_p95_sustained
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > 1.2
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "p95 TTFT > 1.2s for {{ $labels.route }}"
```

Jordan: Where can I get a per-route time-of-day breakdown? Want to check if spikes align with peak tokens/sec.

Sam: Use the 'heatmap' panel on the TTFT dashboard or run:
```promql
sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (route) |> increase_over_time(24h)
```
(that second operator is pseudocode — use Grafana's 'Heatmap' with bucketed time)
Panel link (per-route heatmap): https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ttft/ttft-heatmap?panelId=7

Jordan: Got it, thanks all — I'll correlate traces and tokens/sec and post findings here. :thumbsup:
